Command.Name: SetDeviceTCP_Addresses
Command.FPOperation: Program device's network IP address, subnet mask, gateway address, DNS address. To apply use -SaveNetworkSettings()

Arg.Name: OptionAddressType
Arg.Desc: 1 symbol with value: - '2' - IP address - '3' - Subnet Mask - '4' - Gateway address - '5' - DNS address
